page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and low memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.c2.medium is designed for compute-bound workloads that do not require large memory footprints. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for parallel processing tasks, batch computing, and CPU-intensive operations where dedicated physical core execution is critical and memory overhead is minimal.
